status_reason: 11/12 directed pairs PASS (correct protected-token integrity AND correctly-spaced boundaries); EN->FR FAILED on boundary spacing -- the USER_MENTION+"!" boundary was glued ("<@123...>\xa0!Votre"), even though protected-token integrity itself reported PASS for all 12/12 directions (0 provider errors, 1 HTTP attempt each, 0 integrity retries).

failing_direction.restored_text_excerpt: Salut <@123456789012345678>\xa0!Votre événement {{event_name}} démarre <t:1735689600:F>. Détails : https://example.com/e/{{event_id}} -- utilisez `!rsvp` dans <#234567890123456789>.
failing_direction.root_cause: Google Translate correctly rendered French typography with U+00A0 NO-BREAK SPACE before "!" (legitimate typography, not a defect). DID's own boundary scanner (_skip_horizontal_whitespace in did.messaging.protector) recognized only ASCII SPACE (U+0020) and TAB (U+0009) as horizontal whitespace, so it never advanced past the NBSP to reach the "!" and detect the still-missing whitespace after it. This is NOT a Google placeholder corruption -- the mention placeholder itself was preserved byte-for-byte, and the NBSP is legitimate French typography. The defect is DID's ASCII-only horizontal-whitespace recognizer.

remediation_this_pass.fix: did.messaging.protector._is_horizontal_whitespace widened to recognize TAB or any Unicode category "Zs" (Separator, space) -- covers NO-BREAK SPACE U+00A0, NARROW NO-BREAK SPACE U+202F, and every other Unicode space separator, while deliberately excluding line breaks. Used only to LOCATE punctuation; no pre-punctuation whitespace of any kind is ever rewritten, collapsed, or normalized.
remediation_this_pass.supported_matrix_unchanged: URL->'.', USER_MENTION->'!', TIMESTAMP->'.' -- no new ProtectedKind, no new punctuation added this pass.
remediation_this_pass.next_step: Product owner reruns the exact same 12-direction targeted qualification against the SHA containing this fix, after external audit. Only once 12/12 pass with correctly-spaced boundaries should the 36-row human semantic review pack be regenerated for actual scoring.
